summary.text: Hope Tinker is a physician and the Democratic candidate for Missouri House of Representatives District 48 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican incumbent Tim Taylor.
She retired from clinical practice as a family physician and serves as medical director of Hometown Homecare Hospice in Fayette, according to her Ballotpedia survey.

paragraphs.text: Tinker earned a bachelor's degree from Washington University in 1977 and an M.D. from the University of Missouri, Columbia in 1982.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she said she has lived in Howard County for 40 years and shares a farm with her husband, David Fortel; she said they have four children and four grandchildren.
Tinker named health care, tax revenue, and what she called attacks on democracy as her three key messages in the survey.
On health care, she said rural Missouri is losing access to affordable care and that many residents need coverage through Medicaid or the Affordable Care Act.
